The '''V-series pilot droid''' was a series of [[Pilot droid/Legends|pilot droids]] manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]. Two models were produced in the line: the [[V1 pilot droid]]<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> and the [[V6-series pilot droid]].<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>
